newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Metro Pac sells Phil Cocoa to Nestle.
newsitem.headline: Metro Pac sells Phil Cocoa to Nestle.

text.p: Metro Pacific Corp has reached agreement with Nestle Philippines Inc to dispose of Metro's entire interest in Philippine Cocoa Corp, Metro parent First Pacific Co Ltd said in a statement on Thursday.
The sale will be effective immediately, the statement said.

The disposal of Philippine Cocoa will enable Metro Pacific's consumer products division to focus on the further development of its core personal care and packaged water and wine products, First Pacific said.

Nestle Philippines, a subsidiary of Nestle SA, manufactures and sells a wide range of confectionery products which will be complemented by the acquisition of major local brands and Philippine Cocoa's local production capacity, it said.
The deal will result in a gain of about 150 million pesos on disposal for Metro Pacific in 1997, a First Pacific spokesman said. He declined to disclose the total value of the deal.
Metro Pacific purchased Philippine Cocoa three years ago and held about 98 percent of the company, he said. The unit had turnover of about 700 million pesos in 1996, the spokesman said.
Philippine Cocoa since 1995 has been implementing a major rehabilitation programme of its manufacturing facility to increase capacity and improve operational efficiency, the statement said.
